name: GenFlick
tagline: Chat-driven AI film and video studio for marketing teams and agencies.
description: GenFlick is an AI filmmaking workspace built around a chat interface. Plan a story with an AI Director, work up ideas on a canvas, generate cinematic scenes across multiple models, then publish and hand off social cuts. Aimed at marketing teams, agencies and production studios rather than one-off clip generation.
pricingDetails: Free tier; paid plans from about USD 19.90/month.
features:
AI Director for story planning
Canvas for working up ideas
Multi-model cinematic scene generation
Publishing and social cut hand-off
notes: Verified against the site; listed as submitted.

name: KwaFlux
tagline: Windows AI video enhancer that upscales, restores and stabilises on your own GPU.
description: KwaFlux is a Windows desktop app that enhances video locally on your GPU: upscaling toward 4K, restoring old footage, denoising, stabilising and frame interpolation. Nothing is uploaded for enhancement, so footage stays on your machine. Free 1, 3 and 5 second previews let you check results before buying, and it is sold as a perpetual licence rather than a subscription.
pricingDetails: Free short previews; perpetual licence up to USD 199.99. No subscription.
features:
Runs locally on your GPU - no cloud upload
Upscale toward 4K, restore, denoise, stabilise
Frame interpolation
Free 1/3/5 second previews
Perpetual licence option
notes: Verified: Windows local-GPU enhancer, perpetual licence.

name: MightyMouse
tagline: Use your iPhone as a Mac trackpad, with free on-device dictation.
description: MightyMouse turns an iPhone into a remote trackpad and keyboard for a Mac: see the screen, move the cursor and type from anywhere in the room. It also adds push-to-talk dictation - hold a key, speak, and the text lands in whatever app you are in. Transcription runs locally on the Mac using Whisper, so speech is not sent anywhere. Works with the AI tools you already pay for, or a local model.
pricingDetails: Free tier plus pay-per-page credits. No subscription required.
features:
See your Mac screen from an iPhone
Move the cursor and type remotely
Push-to-talk dictation, transcribed locally
Works with Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode or a local model
notes: Submitted URL carried utm_source=aisocialtools tracking; listed by its clean URL.

name: PDFtoMarkdown.ai
tagline: Converts PDFs into clean Markdown for AI tools, notes apps and RAG pipelines.
description: PDFtoMarkdown.ai turns PDFs into structured Markdown intended for downstream AI use - pasting into Claude or ChatGPT, importing to Obsidian, or feeding RAG pipelines and agents. Handles OCR, tables and images. Available as a web interface, a REST API, and an MCP server so assistants can call it directly.
pricingDetails: Free tier plus pay-per-page credits. No subscription required.
features:
PDF to structured Markdown with OCR
Handles tables and images
REST API
MCP server for direct use by AI assistants
notes: Submitted with no features listed; written from the site.

name: Based on Us
tagline: Turns your photos and story into a personalised comic book.
description: Based on Us makes a custom comic book from your own photos and story. Pick an occasion, art style and characters, upload a photo and answer a few questions, and it produces a fully illustrated comic as a high-resolution PDF plus a gift-wrapped reveal link. Fifteen styles are available and it is aimed at gifts - anniversaries, birthdays and similar.
pricingDetails: From USD 14.99.
features:
Personalised comic from your own photos
Multiple occasions, art styles and characters
High-resolution PDF
Gift-wrapped reveal link
notes: Verified: $14.99 confirmed on the page.

name: Paper Route
tagline: Weekly real-estate reels in your own voice, requested by text message.
description: Paper Route produces short video content for estate agents without filming or templates. It writes ideas, scripts, visuals, narration and captions, and produces reels featuring you, in your branding. Requests and revisions happen over text message, as you would with a colleague, and it remembers your preferences between jobs.
pricingDetails: USD 79 per month.
features:
Original reels featuring you, in your voice and branding
No templates or filming
Ideas, scripts, visuals, narration and captions
Request and revise by text message

Alongside the workflow builder it offers AI voice calling in more than ten Indian languages, document extraction, browser automation and content generation, and connects to tools like Gmail and Slack.
pricingDetails: Freemium; voice calling billed at about INR 1.99/minute.

Visual workflow builder you can watch run
AI voice calling in 10+ Indian languages
Document extraction
Browser automation
Gmail, Slack and other integrations

Text formatting and QR code tools
Developer utilities

name: Ostrata
tagline: Schema-flexible CRM for French SMBs, driven by natural-language chat.
description: Ostrata is a headless CRM where you define your own objects - contacts, companies, deals or anything else - and manage records through conversation rather than forms. Its Pilot assistant runs searches, makes updates and builds live views from chat. It enriches French company records from SIREN/INSEE data, connects to Claude or Cursor over MCP, and offers a REST API and webhooks. EU-hosted. It is not an invoicing tool.
pricingDetails: From EUR 17.10 excl. tax per seat per month billed annually. 7-day trial without a card, or 30 days with one.

Schema-flexible CRM objects you define
Pilot conversational assistant for search and updates
SIREN/INSEE enrichment for French companies
MCP connection for Claude and Cursor
REST API and webhooks, EU-hosted

Media-led discovery

Custom LoRA training

Product photo generation
Image and video generation

name: Pixolm

Camera style guidance for framing
AI creative agent for exploring ideas

name: RAADS-R Test
tagline: Online adult autism screener with a free preview score and optional paid report.
description: RAADS-R Test is an online self-assessment for adults based on the RAADS-R framework, offered as a 42-question quick version or an 80-question deep version. You see your preview score and strongest domains for free, and can optionally pay for a fuller personalised interpretation. The site states plainly that it is built for self-reflection and is not a medical diagnosis - a screener result is not a substitute for assessment by a qualified clinician.
pricingDetails: Free preview score; optional paid full report.
features:
42-question quick test
80-question deep assessment
Free preview score and strongest domains
Optional personalised report

name: WheyIndex
tagline: Independent protein powder index scoring products out of 100 and by cost per 25g.
description: WheyIndex scores protein powders on formulation simplicity, sugar per 25g and value, producing an index out of 100 plus a cost per 25g of protein so products can be compared on what you actually get rather than tub price. pricingDetails: Free to use. Uses affiliate links, which the site says do not change scores.
features:

Cost per 25g of protein

Published methodology

tagline: Credit-based Google indexing service for SEOs, with Brave Search indexing.

Built-in index checker

Brave Search indexing
